lang.name: English
apnote.title: Set up Wi-Fi
apnote.text: The dongle is currently running its own network. Under Settings → Wi-Fi, pick your home network and enter the password – it will then switch over. If joining fails, it reopens this network after about 15 seconds.
hero.unreachable.sub: The dongle's Wi-Fi is off, or it is restarting.
hero.sleeping.sub: Paired – it connects on the next button press.
hero.unpaired.sub: Hold the remote right next to the dongle and press Back + Volume Up for about 5 seconds.
hero.battery: Remote battery almost empty ({pct} %) – please charge.
live.hint: Live: pressed buttons light up. Click a button to open its mapping.
remote.title: Remote
remote.pairhint: To pair again: hold the remote right next to the dongle and press Back + Volume Up for about 5 seconds. This only works while no remote is stored.
dongle.title: Dongle
dongle.hint: With Wi-Fi off, this page is unreachable too – the remote keeps working. To turn it back on: press the BOOT button on the dongle briefly{siri}.
dongle.hint.siri: or hold the remote's Siri button for 5 seconds
led.flash: A flash every 2 seconds – paired, remote asleep
led.slow: Slow blinking{violet} – own hotspot open, set up Wi-Fi
led.yellow: Three blinks{yellow} – Wi-Fi was switched on or off
led.boot: BOOT button on the dongle: short press = Wi-Fi on/off · hold 3 seconds (LED blinks red) = unpair remote · hold 10 seconds (LED white) = factory reset. It acts on release.
profile.label: Profile
profile.name: Profile name
profile.reset.failed: The defaults could not be loaded.
profile.hint: Four profiles can be mapped and named separately. The one selected here becomes active on the dongle with “Save”; “Load default” resets only this one profile to its built-in mapping.
ed.ir: The remote also sends volume up, volume down and mute over infrared by itself – using the codes it once learned for your TV on an Apple TV. If your TV reacts to them, TV and media player both change volume; in that case set this button to “Nothing”. Do not rely on the infrared: sometimes it survives pairing, sometimes it does not.
ed.follow: Jump to a button automatically when it is pressed on the remote
ed.hint: Pressed buttons light up live on the left. USB key codes are sent (US layout); holding a button repeats it – the connected device takes care of that.
set.led.title: Status LED
set.led.dark: off while the remote is connected
set.led.hint: Default for the ESP32-S3 Super Mini: RGB LED on GPIO 48. A wrong pin can interfere with other functions of the board – if in doubt, choose “none”.
set.conn.title: Connection to the remote
set.conn.interval.sub: shorter = faster response, more battery drain
set.conn.hint: The interval applies from the next connection. The remote buffers button presses while it is disconnected and delivers them on connecting; the filter suppresses such leftovers.
wifi.title: Home network
wifi.hint: Without a saved Wi-Fi the dongle opens the open network siri-bridge-setup, address http://192.168.4.1. If the dongle is unreachable after a wrong manual address: holding BOOT for 10 seconds restores the factory state.
wifi.need: Please pick a network or scan first.
wifi.badip: Please enter address and subnet mask as four numbers separated by dots.
wifi.badgw: Please enter gateway and DNS server as four numbers separated by dots, or leave them empty.
wifi.done.static: Saved – the dongle will be reachable at http://{ip} in a moment.
wifi.done.dhcp: Saved – the dongle is now switching to the Wi-Fi.
reach.title: Availability of this page
reach.auto.sub: after this time without access to the page
reach.hint: With “always on”, this page is reachable in your home network at any time – without a password, firmware update included. The dongle's own hotspot always switches off after 10 minutes without access.
fw.title: Firmware update
fw.nofile.label: No file chosen
fw.hint: Choose the …-ota.bin file from the release, not the merged file. Pairing and settings are kept; the dongle restarts afterwards.
fw.merged: That is the full image. For an update, choose the …-ota.bin.
fw.sent: Firmware uploaded. The dongle is restarting and will be reachable again in about 10 seconds …
fw.aborted: Connection lost – the update was not installed.
fw.ok: Firmware update successful: {before} → {after}. The dongle is running again.
fw.same: The dongle is running again, the version is unchanged ({version}). Either it was the same firmware, or the new one crashed on startup and was discarded.
fw.silent: The dongle does not respond. If it was given a new address, your router will show it.
backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: Back up downloads button mapping, LED and the options of this page as a JSON file – without the Wi-Fi password and without the pairing. Load reads such a file; it only reaches the dongle with Save.
backup.stored: “{file}” is now saved on the dongle.
backup.loaded.dirty: “{file}” loaded – not on the dongle yet. Apply with “Save”.
backup.loaded.same: “{file}” loaded – matches the dongle's current configuration.
backup.loaded.toast: Configuration loaded – apply to the dongle with “Save”.
backup.invalid: “{file}” is not a valid configuration file.
backup.invalid.toast: That is not a valid configuration file.
reset.title: Reset
reset.wifi.text: Deletes the saved Wi-Fi credentials. The dongle then opens its own network “siri-bridge-setup”.
reset.wifi.done: Wi-Fi forgotten – the dongle opens its own network siri-bridge-setup.
reset.settings.text: Button mapping, LED and the options of this page back to default. Pairing and Wi-Fi are kept.
reset.factory.text: Deletes everything: pairing with the remote, settings and Wi-Fi. The dongle restarts as if freshly flashed.
reset.factory.done: Factory state restored – the dongle restarts and opens its own network.
done.wifioff: Wi-Fi is being turned off – this page will be unreachable in a moment.
